summary.text: Dave Hardesty is an independent candidate for the Wyoming House of Representatives, District 31, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Douglas Moore (R) is also on the ballot.

paragraphs.text: Dave Hardesty was also an independent candidate for Wyoming House of Representatives District 31 in 2018, when incumbent Scott Clem (R) won the general election with 69.0 percent of the vote to Hardesty's 30.8 percent.
Ballotpedia lists his 2018 campaign contributions at $5,848.
